name: v2 PostgreSQL password guessing
description: PostgreSQL password-authentication failures for three or more distinct accounts on one database host within 10 minutes — guessing across account names rather than one client with a stale password. Keyed on distinct user.name because the stream carries a constant single-account failure (the elastic-agent PostgreSQL metrics collector logs in as 'root' over ::1 every few seconds with no credentials). The log lines carry no client address; the pg_hba.conf line in the paired DETAIL row says whether the connection was local (::1/128) or remote (0.0.0.0/0), and network telemetry names the source.
